distribution: Jinxiu, Guangxi (altitude 800 m); Guangdong; Fujian; Jiangxi.
soldier: Fontanelle pore about 0.06 mm in diameter, like a small hill in lateral view, rising above the surface of the vertex. Labrum semicircular, wider than long, the labral margin semi-transparent and bearing more than 10 long setae. Both mandibles sabre-shaped, rather stout, the apices slightly curved. The middle to lower part of the inner margin of the left mandible bears a small triangular tooth, and at the corresponding position on the right mandible, slightly nearer the base, there is a similar small tooth. Antennae 12–14-segmented, segment 3 rather long and obconical; the flange over the antennal socket rather short, unable to cover the lateral margins of the head. Compound eyes vestigial, faintly discernible behind the antennal socket. Postmentum club-shaped, broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly, the anterior margin slightly convex, its middle section concealed in lateral view within the outwardly bowed lower margin of the head. Pronotum rather kidney-shaped, the anterior margin slightly upturned, the angle of the median concavity about 150 degrees, the posterior margin rather shallowly concave, the lateral margins strongly contracted backwards. Femora stout and inflated, tibiae slender.
